title: Retreat behind trees: when hurt, hit and no building cover is in reach, retreat to a spot within 3 s that trees hide from every enemy seeing us, instead of backing straight away (TREE_RETREAT_ON)
behaviors: in the champion's 'retreat' branch (HP < retreatHp, hit in the last 2 s, no building hide spot), t >= 10, when trees+buildings do not already hide us from every enemy with line of sight: walk (boost above 30% energy, as today) to the nearest in-zone spot 1, 2 or 3 s away, no closer to any of those enemies, that trees+buildings hide from all of them; give up after 3 s without progress
owner: unassigned (research P41-44 trees follow-up; Grok assigns)
next_action: Grok: assign or park. If built: one flag TREE_RETREAT_ON default false; trees-on base-0 hazard with fired / different behavior / different score, deaths within 10 s of a trigger, damage taken in retreat, drop-ring arrivals, pins >= 20 s, deaths < 40 s.
single_decision: Where the no-cover retreat goes. Today, with no building spot from hideSpot, it backs away from lastHit's bearing with a lean toward the center (brain.ts:780-794). This picks a tree-hidden spot instead when one exists; 'retreat to cover' (building spot, brain.ts:774-779) is unchanged.
trigger: TREE_RETREAT_ON AND obs.t >= 10 AND mode === 'retreat' (brain.ts:794) AND enemies with seenAt(me.pos, myHeight, [e], false) non-empty AND NOT already hidden from all of them by trees+buildings AND a tree spot exists AND NOT (near-and-reachable drop OR dropMove OR dropHold).
hook: brain.ts act(), no-cover retreat branch brain.ts:780-794: before the back-away vector, if TREE_RETREAT_ON and a tree spot exists, `move = heading(treeSpot)`; keep boost and mode 'retreat'. Same tree loader and tree-aware hidden test as P45 (shared helper, one flag here). Flag in params.ts.
gates: Not before t = 10 s. Only in the champion's hurt retreat (HP < 0.3 and hit within 2 s); the drop run needs HP >= retreatHp and !hurt (brain.ts:731), so it cannot be running the same tick; the near-and-reachable drop gate is applied anyway. 3 s no-progress give-up. Off = champion exactly.
drop_gate: Drop gate (Doug 8:58 PM ET rule, near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M): the rule is off on any tick where a drop passes the champion's own drop-run candidate filter (not in dropSkip, holder null or us, flat distance <= DROP_RUN_M, zone-safe for lands_in + capture time; brain.ts:731-736) or dropMove/dropHold is on, and it yields to a drop run/hold on the same tick. A plain 'no drop listed' gate is not used (an untaken drop sits in obs.drops most of the game; it killed P26b, P33, P29b).
tree_model: Tree cover test (observable: the kit map files hello.map.dir/v2/world.json, 1560 trees, rules.canopyDensity 0.35, canopyBlockT 0.25; protocol.md:369-372, :452): a spot p is hidden from enemy e when both e's eye-to-our-center and eye-to-our-top lines are blocked by a building (map.ts clearLine) or by a tree: a trunk always, canopy only when e is beyond near_range 45 m and the transmittance exp(-0.35 x metres inside crowns) is below 0.25. Shots ignore trees (protocol.md:317), so hiding behind a tree does not stop our own fire.

evidence.protocol: protocol.md:369-372: canopy is soft, trunks block sight, canopy does not block inside near_range 45 m; :317 trees do not stop shots; :452 world.json trees. Our bot never reads trees: map.ts:119 clearLine covers buildings/terrain only, and seenAt (brain.ts:405) and hideSpot (brain.ts:425) use it.
evidence.sim_trees_on: Champion trees-on baselines (/workspace/tester/runs): P29 b6f2f8b mean (16-place) 3.562 -> 3.708 (2000+3000) and 3.870 -> 4.083 (4000+5000) when trees are switched on; deaths before 40 s 56 -> 48 and 54 -> 38. P34 0e6fadd trees on: 3.750 and 4.099, deaths before 40 s 48 and 38. Trees on is now the official screen (coord/WORKFLOW.md 475eb09).
evidence.sim_retreat: Trees on, P34 champion: in the champion's no-cover 'retreat' with an enemy in line of sight, trees already hide us at some point in 59 and 60 games, and a tree spot within 3 s exists (trigger) in 107 and 104 games (reach gate).
evidence.sim_deaths: Trees on: 93 of 190 deaths (2000+3000) and 89 of 189 (4000+5000) had a P46 trigger (reach gate) in the 10 s before death.
evidence.watcher: evasion_slices.csv (RANKED.md #1): at 2-4 alive, top teams keep the nearest enemy at 126 m vs 90 m while HP < 35% (d=0.71, 447/249 ticks, 43/43 matches, ok) and move faster when hurt (8.94 vs 6.95 m/s, d=0.35): breaking contact when hurt separates top teams. PR #145: someone else hitting me KILL 37 / DIED 128.
evidence.kept_parent: B5 retreat to building cover (F3) is in the champion and was a KEEP (B5b 2.38); this extends the same decision to tree cover where the champion has no building spot.

trigger_counts_trees_on.gates: Gates as counted: none; plain = obs.drops empty; narrow = no drop (holder null or us) within DROP_RUN_M and no dropMove/dropHold; reach = 'near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M' (Doug 8:58 PM ET follow-up): no drop that passes the champion's own drop-run candidate filter (not in dropSkip, holder null or us, within DROP_RUN_M, zone-safe for lands_in + capture time; brain.ts:731-736 on main 8c130ad) and no dropMove/dropHold that tick. Spec gate = reach.

closest_prior_test: B5/B5b retreat to building cover KEEP (in the stack). HYP-019 retreat route failed (cited in P-D-007 Step A); P33 retreat-far RETIRED (0/96 behind the plain drop gate); B123 hurt kiting VETO; P30 front-arc facing while retreating RETIRED. None used tree cover; this changes only the no-cover retreat's destination.
what_would_disprove: Trees-on paired screen: deaths within 10 s of a trigger not lower, or damage taken during retreat not lower; drop-ring set totals below the champion; deaths < 40 s above; new 20 s+ pins with the flag active; official score at or below the champion.
risks: Pins: movement to trunks/slopes; 3 s give-up needed. A tree spot can be sideways rather than away, so a chaser inside 45 m (canopy does not hide there; only trunks) may keep sight; the spot test only counts canopy beyond 45 m. Drops: cannot coincide with a drop run (hurt). Early deaths: off before 10 s.
